facts.fact: The Direction Generale des Douanes says SYDONIA World has been the central platform dematerialising customs procedures, in operation since 2018.

The Direction Generale des Douanes says a UNCTAD expert's functional and technical audit of SYDONIA World defined the evolutions needed to strengthen its performance, interoperability and security, with the aim of evolving it into a more integrated platform.

note: The single window is described only as a needs assessment for its deployment, not as in service; no exchange of data with another country's customs is stated.
